raw_record.original_question:
下图示意的是我国正在建设中的敦煌至格尔木铁路(T)。据图，T铁路开通后，由敦煌至格尔木的路程大为缩短，不再绕行的甲省级行政区中心城市是哪里？

<image1>

Reasoning: The question asks for the “central city of the provincial-level administrative region Jia” that will no longer be detoured through after railway T opens from Dunhuang to Golmud. According to the location shown in the figure, Jia is located in eastern Gansu Province, around the eastern end of the Hexi Corridor, corresponding to the central city of the provincial-level administrative region of Gansu Province. The capital of Gansu Province is Lanzhou. Therefore the answer is Lanzhou.
